tutorial_text.text:
BASHING

The bash is a versatile maneuver, with merits both offensively and defensively.

Bashes inflict a period of stun that lasts roughly four beats.

While under this effect, attacking is not possible, nor any attempts to defend.



BASH STUN

Attacking the enemy during bash stun will bypass their guard and end the stun effect early.

Any special attacks the enemy performs will cut any ongoing bash stun time in half.



POSTURE BREAK

When the enemy's posture is full, an attack during bash stun will deal critical damage, and reduce posture by a moderate amount.
